most_similar_reason: Candidate 9 matches the target most closely as a bearded/serpent culture-hero creator who fashions the present humankind after earlier failed races were destroyed, teaches civilization (books, calendar, crops, food preparation), works wonders, and finally departs in disgrace/transfiguration with the expectation of celestial return.
least_similar_reason: Candidate 5 is least similar: it is a dynastic penance-and-river-descent legend about funeral rites for ancestors, with no creator figure, no fashioning of humans, no civilizing teaching, and no departing culture hero.
